strafe.definition:
n. an attack of machine-gun fire or cannon fire from a low flying airplane
v. attack with machine guns or cannon fire from a low-flying plane
strafe.translation:
vt. 猛烈炮轰, 惩罚, 用机枪扫射, 损害
n. 猛烈炮轰, 机枪扫射, 损害

strafed.definition: v attack with machine guns or cannon fire from a low-flying plane
strafed.translation: v. 用机枪扫射, 猛烈炮轰, 惩罚( strafe的过去式和过去分词 )

strafer.definition: n. a combat pilot who strafes the enemy

strafes.definition:
n an attack of machine-gun fire or cannon fire from a low flying airplane
v attack with machine guns or cannon fire from a low-flying plane
strafes.translation: v. 用机枪扫射, 猛烈炮轰, 惩罚( strafe的第三人称单数 )

strafing.definition: v attack with machine guns or cannon fire from a low-flying plane
strafing.translation: v. 用机枪扫射, 猛烈炮轰, 惩罚( strafe的现在分词 )
